{\footnotesize\raggedright Tests: the number of test functions (each may be parametrised) in \code{tests/analytic/test_mcmc_twin.py}, \code{tests/analytic/test_mode1_quadrature.py}, \code{tests/analytic/test_structural_nig.py}, \code{tests/mcmc/blocks/test_cccm.py}, \code{tests/mcmc/blocks/test_sv_toy_quadrature.py} at commit 888f620; cadence from their \code{slow} markers (PR: every pull request; weekly: the CI job named ``nightly''). CDF form: each exact quantile $x_q$ is tested by $z = (\hat F_{\mathrm{MCMC}}(x_q) - q)/\sqrt{\mathrm{MCSE}^2 + q(1-q)/N_{\mathrm{ref}}}$ with the indicator's own ESS. A negative control passes when the comparison rejects the perturbed oracle.\par}
